identity.mission: Create a club management app that feels like a community hub, not a spreadsheet. Balance administrative utility with member-facing warmth.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix 'Swiss Utility' (Admin) with 'Soft Community' (Public).
Emotion First: Trust for admins, Welcoming for members.
Content is King: The member status is the hero.
Zoom In: Focus on the status indicators—make them clear and satisfying.
Negative Space: Don't cram the public list; let it breathe.

headings.usage: All page titles, modal headers, and major section dividers.

body.usage: Table data, form inputs, standard text.

rules: Labels must be Uppercase + Tiny (text-xs) + Wide Spacing (tracking-widest).

primary.name: Royal Azure
primary.usage: Primary buttons, active states, key branding elements.

colors.theme_strategy: Light Mode Only (as requested). Use 'Bone White' to avoid clinical harshness.

layout.spacing_system: Tailwind Scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16. Containers with borders MUST have p-6 or p-8 internal padding.

public_view.description: Hero section with community image (col-span-full), followed by a card grid for members.

admin_dashboard.description: Sidebar layout. Main content uses a tight table layout for maximum data visibility.

buttons.interaction: Transform: scale-105 on hover. Shadow-lg on hover.

cards.style: Flat with 1px border (border-neutral-border). No shadow by default. Shadow-md on hover.
cards.classes: bg-white border border-border hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

tables.style: Clean rows. No vertical borders. Header uppercase and muted.
tables.status_pills: Use badge component. Green for Paid, Red for Unpaid.

inputs.style: Shadcn Input. Customize focus ring to match Royal Azure.

textures.usage: Subtle noise overlay on the 'Bone White' background to add tactility.

images.description: Diverse group of happy friends taking a selfie. Use for Public Page Hero.
Abstract white geometric low poly background. Use for Login Page background.

media.icons: Use Lucide-React (default). For specific feature icons, use Phosphor Icons if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup: Ensure Tailwind config extends the colors defined above.
2. Login Page: Create a centered card layout on the 'login_background'. Use Google Auth button.
3. Public Page: Create a 'Member Status Board'. Use the 'hero_community' image at the top with a welcoming message. Below, list members with their payment status (Paid/Unpaid) clearly visible.
4. Admin Dashboard: Create a secure layout (Sidebar + Content). Feature a 'Member Management' table with CRUD actions and a 'Fee Tracking' view (Matrix of Months vs Members).
5. Testing: Add data-testid to all buttons, inputs, and status indicators.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic gradients, no centered text everywhere.
Micro-animations: Add hover states to every interactive element.
Spacing: Use p-8 where you'd normally use p-4.
Contrast: Ensure text is readable on the 'Bone White' background.
No 'Transparent' Backgrounds: Always use a blur or solid color for dropdowns/headers.
